054/**
055 * PaperPlugin
056 *
057 * @author creatorfromhell
058 * @since 0.1.2.0
059 */
060public class PaperPlugin {
061
062  private PaperPluginCore pluginCore;
063  private TNECore core;
064  private boolean papiHooked = false;
065
066  public void load(final JavaPlugin plugin) {
067
068    load(plugin, new PaperCore(plugin), new PaperServerProvider(new PaperInventoryCalculations()));
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Called when the plugin is loaded by the Bukkit plugin manager. This method should be used to
073   * initialize any necessary resources or data.
074   */
075  public void load(final JavaPlugin plugin, final TNECore core, final ServerConnector provider) {
076
077    //Initialize our TNE Core Class
078    this.core = core;
079    this.pluginCore = new PaperPluginCore(plugin, core, provider, new BaseTranslationProvider(), new TNECallbackProvider());
080
081    this.pluginCore.load();
082
083    //Vault
084    PluginCore.log().inform("Checking for VaultUnlocked");
085    try {
086      Class.forName("net.milkbowl.vault2.economy.Economy");
087      new VaultUnlockedHook().register();
088    } catch(final Exception ignore) {
089      PluginCore.log().error("Unable to connect to VaultUnlocked!");
090    }
091
092    PluginCore.log().inform("Checking for Vault");
093    try {
094      Class.forName("net.milkbowl.vault.economy.Economy");
095      new VaultHook().register();
096    } catch(final Exception ignore) {
097      PluginCore.log().error("Unable to connect to vault!");
098    }
099  }
100
101  /**
102   * Called by the Bukkit plugin manager when the plugin is enabled. This method should be used to
103   * enable the functionality provided by this class.
104   */
105  public void enable(final JavaPlugin plugin) {
106
107    PaperRegistryConversions.register();
108    PaperComponentCompatibility.register();
109    PaperItemPlatform.instance().addItemProvider(new PaperVanillaProvider());
110    if(PaperItemPlatform.instance().useModern()) {
111      PaperNestedItems.register();
112      PaperPreservedComponents.register();
113      PaperItemPlatform.instance().addMulti(new PaperPersistentItemComponent());
114    }
115
116    this.pluginCore.enable();
117
118    //Register our event listeners
119    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new EntityKilledListener(), plugin);
120    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerExperienceGainListener(), plugin);
121
122    //Player Listeners
123    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerJoinListener(), plugin);
124    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerQuitListener(), plugin);
125
126    //Menu-related Listeners from TNML
127    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerCloseInventoryListener(), plugin);
128    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PlayerInteractListener(), plugin);
129
130    //World Listeners
131    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new WorldLoadListener(), plugin);
132
133    //Inventory listeners
134    Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new ItemCraftListener(), plugin);
135
136    //Register our service providers.
137
138    //PAPI
139    if(Bukkit.getPluginManager().isPluginEnabled("PlaceholderAPI")) {
140      new PAPIHook().register();
141
142      CurrencyFormatter.addRule(new PlaceHolderRule());
143    } else {
144      Bukkit.getPluginManager().registerEvents(new PluginEnableListener(), plugin);
145    }
146
147    final Metrics metrics = new Metrics(plugin, 34093);
148
149    plugin.getLogger().log(Level.INFO, "The New Economy has been enabled!");
150  }
151
152  /**
153   * Called by the Bukkit plugin manager when the plugin is disabled. This method should be used to
154   * disable the functionality provided by this class.
155   */
156  public void disable(final JavaPlugin plugin) {
157
158    unregisterCommands(plugin);
159    this.pluginCore.onDisable();
160  }
161
162  /**
163   * Paper keeps a disabled plugin's Brigadier commands but closes its class loader. Tab completing
164   * one of them then fails to load TNE classes, and that error stops the server. This happens
165   * whenever TNE is disabled while the server runs, including when its startup fails.
166   */
167  private static void unregisterCommands(final JavaPlugin plugin) {
168
169    try {
170      final Map<String, Command> known = Bukkit.getCommandMap().getKnownCommands();
171      final List<String> labels = known.entrySet().stream()
172              .filter(entry->entry.getValue() instanceof final PluginIdentifiableCommand command
173                             && command.getPlugin() == plugin)
174              .map(Map.Entry::getKey)
175              .toList();
176      if(labels.isEmpty()) {
177        return;
178      }
179
180      //CommandNode#removeCommand is added by Paper and is not part of its API.
181      final Object root = dispatcherRoot();
182      final Method remove = root.getClass().getMethod("removeCommand", String.class);
183      for(final String label : labels) {
184        known.remove(label);
185        remove.invoke(root, label);
186      }
187      Bukkit.getOnlinePlayers().stream().filter(Bukkit::isOwnedByCurrentRegion).forEach(Player::updateCommands);
188    } catch(final ReflectiveOperationException | RuntimeException e) {
189      plugin.getLogger().log(Level.WARNING, "Unable to unregister TNE commands; tab completing them may fail until restart.", e);
190    }
191  }
192
193  private static Object dispatcherRoot() throws ReflectiveOperationException {
194
195    final Object server = Bukkit.getServer().getClass().getMethod("getServer").invoke(Bukkit.getServer());
196    final Object commands = server.getClass().getMethod("getCommands").invoke(server);
197    final Object dispatcher = commands.getClass().getMethod("getDispatcher").invoke(commands);
198    return dispatcher.getClass().getMethod("getRoot").invoke(dispatcher);
199  }
200
201  public boolean isPapiHooked() {
202
203    return papiHooked;
204  }
205
206  public void setPapiHooked(final boolean papiHooked) {
207
208    this.papiHooked = papiHooked;
209  }
210}
